# Pulse task #2827: Resize all track heights with Alt and toggle a header-only overview with H

Operation: 2ac238b9352522f7d245986ddf2c33da
Assignee: PORTALSURFER (Pulse #1, GitHub ID 41680373)

User requests a focused extension to merged track resizing #2714/PR330. Drag a track's height edge normally to resize that track. Hold Alt/Option while resizing to set ALL track heights to the same resulting height, aligned smoothly as one gesture. The final minimum is explicitly HEADER ONLY, not merely half the old minimum: very thin rows where the clip name/title header remains visible. The user revised their tentative 'half' suggestion to this header-only target; do not use half as a separate requirement.

User additionally requests H as a toggle between normal custom-sized rows (every track at the size the user left it) and a compact header-only overview of all tracks. Toggling compact must not overwrite the custom per-track heights; H again restores the exact individual heights, including prior Alt uniform sizing. Define sensible handling of tracks created/deleted while compact without stale-index restoration. Preserve stable track identity, existing horizontal header resizing, scroll/layout/hit coordinates and clip selection/drag/trim, audio/MIDI lanes, Return/Main row layout as applicable to their existing supported resizing model. Avoid compressing unrelated toolbars or rendering controls outside their rows. Header-only clips must keep name text readable and selection borders visible, with body/waveforms safely clipped/hidden when no body space remains. Track controls may require compact rendering appropriate to existing controls; do not allow overlapped invisible hit targets.

H is a workspace shortcut only: do not trigger from search, track/clip name editing, numeric controls, text/IME composition, modal input or other text consumers. Inspect existing H bindings before implementation and escalate a real conflict. Do not invent another shortcut silently. Actual gesture/key tests must cover all-track Alt resize, limits, live header/lane alignment, H round-trip with differing saved sizes, repeated toggles, track insertion/removal, and text focus. Verify custom heights are preserved according to the existing project/UI preference architecture, no unrelated migration work.

Source1 owns prior height implementation and takes this after essential #2815 first-attempt Open/unsaved prompt fixes and current coherent returned repairs, coordinating source6's separate clip-header color/border files. One focused canonical PR, targeted local checks and immutable handoff to sole merge agent. Source-ready remains In Progress until actual merge; native checks only in root's serial Mac lane, no live user-app input, installation or forced quit.
